direction: Editorial Arabian luxury with restrained gold-on-ink interaction design
decisions: Use the existing fixed spider graph as a performance frame rather than changing metrics between slides.
The performance carousel contains exactly two falcon portrait banners with explicit names, visible arrows, and a two-tab navigation bar.
Portrait transitions use a soft crossfade and scale while navigation remains high contrast and keyboard accessible.
Meet the Falcons uses a 21st-inspired editorial reveal: staggered card entrances, vertical image masks, restrained hover zoom, and a single gold scan accent with reduced-motion support.
